description: This source file defines the `TranscriptsStore` actor which manages a storage of transcript entries, including initialization from disk, appending new entries, and retrieving the latest entries. It also extends the String class with a method to append lines to a file.

classes.name: TranscriptsStore
classes.description: An actor class that manages a collection of transcript entries, persisting them to a file in the user's application support directory.

classes.name: String (extension)
classes.description: An extension of the String class adding a method to append the string as a line to a specified file URL.

methods.name: TranscriptsStore.init()
methods.description: Initializes the TranscriptsStore, creating the storage directory if needed, and loads existing entries from the log file.

methods.name: TranscriptsStore.append(text:)
methods.description: Appends a new transcript entry to the in-memory list and persists the updated list to disk, maintaining a maximum of 100 entries.

methods.name: TranscriptsStore.latest()
methods.description: Returns the current list of transcript entries.

methods.name: String.appendLine(to:)
methods.description: Appends the string as a new line to the specified file URL, creating the file if it does not exist.
